prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1347; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Front bumper cover cracked and displaced on the driver side, with the upper radiator support bracket bent and the hood latch assembly distorted. The headlamp assembly on that side is cracked, and the grille mounting tabs are broken. The damage pattern lines up with the reported frontal contact, and the crush depth stays within what a low-speed impact would produce. No prior damage to this vehicle is known or recorded. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, headlamp, grille and latch, followed by a radiator support alignment and refinish of the front end. The labor hours submitted fit the scope of this work, and the supplement invoices contain no duplicated line items.
